reason:
The heading that opens section 1 is printed without its number, alone among the edition's twenty-two. Every other section heading on the page carries one -- '2. Primeiras palavras do novo Pontificado' through '22. A Mãe da nossa confiança' -- in the same '

N. Title

' form, so the omission is a defect in this one heading rather than a convention. The consequence is not cosmetic: with no number to open it, section 1's prose is claimed by nothing and drops out of the parse entirely, and validate_document reports 'numbering starts at 2, not 1'. What is lost is the encyclical's opening sentence, 'O Redentor do homem, Jesus Cristo, é o centro do cosmos e da história'. The correct value is not inferred from the sibling alone -- the surrounding headings fix it by themselves, since 2 follows it and nothing else can precede a 2 -- but the EN edition agrees.
